name: com.worldstroll/worldstroll
title: World Stroll
description: Country guides and geography games: country of the day, flags, maps and facts.

tools.name: country_guide
tools.description: A short, fact-checked guide to any country of the world from World Stroll, a free armchair travel site for adults and seniors: region, capital, languages and currency for every country; for countries with a full trip also the main dishes, key moments of history, a fun fact and a few phrases with pronunciation. Returns a link to the full trip with map, recipes, pictures and a friendly quiz (no timer), and a free large-print printable pack for groups.

country.description: Country name, code or capital, e.g. "Italy", "JP", "Lima"

tools.name: geography_games
tools.description: World Stroll's daily geography puzzles (Mystery Country, Dish of the Day, Flag of the Day, Warmer Colder), the same for everyone each day, and free printables: a weekly trivia night pack, large-print word searches, Country of the Week packs for care homes, libraries and clubs, and a five-minute warm-up for teachers. Use when someone wants a geography game, a quiz for seniors or an activity for a group.
